calculations.name: Gross sales
calculations.formula: sum(item_price*qty) shipped/ordered per basis, tax basis per market setting

calculations.name: Net sales
calculations.formula: gross sales − promo discounts − refunded principal (counted once: refund_principal_in = sales | refund_cost, never both) − output tax (India CM and all margin denominators use net sales ex GST/VAT)

calculations.name: Marketplace fees (by taxonomy)
calculations.formula: sum of classified fee events; unknown codes → 'Unclassified' bucket, never dropped

calculations.name: Refund cost
calculations.formula: refunded amount ex tax (only when refund_principal_in = refund_cost) − fee reversals + refund admin fee; refund-reason dimension

calculations.name: COGS — fixed/period
calculations.formula: qty × unit cost effective at order date (period policy)

calculations.name: COGS — weighted average
calculations.formula: qty × running weighted average at order date

calculations.name: COGS — FIFO with oversold policy
calculations.formula: consume batches in receipt order; oversold → policy(last batch|zero|fixed) + alert

calculations.name: Landed cost per unit
calculations.formula: (purchase + freight + duty + insurance + inbound) / units received

calculations.name: Unsellable return cost
calculations.formula: unsellable/pending-as-unsellable → COGS not restored; recovery % of COGS ('value of unsellable returns'); settings: COGS zero for all refunded | only restocked; condition overrides restocking fee

calculations.name: Product gross profit
calculations.formula: net sales - fees - refund cost - COGS - shipping - payment fees

calculations.name: Contribution before advertising
calculations.formula: gross profit - variable expenses

calculations.name: Contribution after advertising
calculations.formula: contribution before ads - attributed ad spend

calculations.name: Management net profit
calculations.formula: contribution after ads - indirect expenses (allocated)

calculations.name: Margins (gross & net; denominator setting)
calculations.formula: net profit / basis; basis = Sales (tax-incl.) or Sales − output tax ('use net sales'); GP margin = GP / basis; null when basis ≤ 0

calculations.name: ROI
calculations.formula: net profit / COGS; null when COGS=0

calculations.name: ASP
calculations.formula: product revenue / units sold (non-refunded basis)

calculations.name: AOV
calculations.formula: compat Sales / orders (tax-inclusive basis as displayed); ex-tax variant labelled

calculations.name: Conversion (unit session %)
calculations.formula: units / sessions (Amazon Sales & Traffic report)

calculations.name: Return rate
calculations.formula: refunded units / shipped units in window

calculations.name: Shipping cost (profiles)
calculations.formula: profile rules: none | = customer-charged | by order price | units | weight; tiers; zones/domestic-international; shipping-method mapping; date ranges (retroactive); precedence most-specific product then latest start; per-order import overrides; multi-product sum | highest

calculations.name: Pick & pack
calculations.formula: per order + per item; different first-X-items rate

calculations.name: Payment / gateway fee
calculations.formula: (platform third-party fee % + gateway %) × captured amount + fixed fee per gateway; 'Auto' = actual transaction fee; actual replaces estimate

calculations.name: Cost allocation conservation
calculations.formula: sum(allocated) == total allocated, rounding remainder to largest share

calculations.name: Expense recognition schedule
calculations.formula: one-off/recurring/daily amortization of fees; closed period untouched

calculations.name: Tax / GST / TCS / withholding treatment
calculations.formula: recoverable vs non-recoverable per setting & start date; India Item TDS presentation setting: in Amazon fees (Sellerboard-compatible) | recoverable asset — applied to both P&L views

calculations.name: FX conversion
calculations.formula: rate by policy(date=order|posted|settlement) ; reporting currency; stored source currency

calculations.name: Settlement bridge
calculations.formula: sum(events in settlement) == payout amount; variance shown

calculations.name: ROAS
calculations.formula: attributed ad sales / spend
calculations.note: OMITTED v0.3 — marketing function removed by Owner 2026-10-10; not to be built

calculations.name: ACOS
calculations.formula: spend / attributed ad sales
calculations.note: OMITTED v0.3 — marketing function removed by Owner 2026-10-10; not to be built

calculations.name: TACOS
calculations.formula: advertising cost (CALC-079) / compat Sales (tax-inclusive)

calculations.name: Real ACOS (product-scoped)
calculations.formula: product ad spend / product total sales

calculations.name: Attribution overlap
calculations.formula: order attributed by multiple models → union count once; per-model views separate
calculations.note: OMITTED v0.3 — marketing function removed by Owner 2026-10-10; not to be built

calculations.name: Observed LTV
calculations.formula: cumulative net sales per buyer over window; maturity flag

calculations.name: CAC
calculations.formula: acquisition spend / new customers

calculations.name: Retention / repeat rate
calculations.formula: buyers with ≥2 orders / buyers

calculations.name: Payback period
calculations.formula: months until cumulative contribution ≥ CAC

calculations.name: Sales velocity (weighted windows, OOS-adjusted)
calculations.formula: Σ_w weight_w × units_w / in-stock days_w over windows 3/7/30/60/180 (weights editable, default .15/.15/.30/.25/.15); OOS days excluded; × seasonality coefficient when enabled

calculations.name: Days of cover
calculations.formula: (available + reserved) / velocity; velocity 0 → null

calculations.name: Reorder quantity
calculations.formula: velocity × (1 + growth_pct) × season × (manufacturing + shipping + buffer + target stock days) − (available + reserved + incoming + AWD + ordered, split POs counted once); ≥0; round up to MOQ/carton (PROPOSED; exact vendor formula NF)

calculations.name: Inventory movement reconciliation
calculations.formula: open + received - shipped - removed ± adjustments == close

calculations.name: Price floor & ROI
calculations.formula: min price = (COGS+fees+ship+profit floor)/(1-ref%)-... ; never round below floor

calculations.name: Review request eligibility
calculations.formula: 5–30 days after delivery, no prior request, not excluded
calculations.note: OMITTED v0.3 — marketing function removed by Owner 2026-10-10; not to be built

calculations.name: Alert deduplication
calculations.formula: hash(type, entity, condition) within TTL

calculations.name: Claim realization
calculations.formula: realized credit vs candidate amount; aging

calculations.name: Forecast vs actual
calculations.formula: run-rate forecast = MTD/elapsed×days; variance

calculations.name: Application TCO
calculations.formula: capex-candidate + expensed + recurring opex over horizon

calculations.name: Multichannel dedup
calculations.formula: Shopify order + MCF/WFS fulfilment record → one sale on Shopify channel; MCF fees + COGS assigned to Shopify; Amazon view excludes when 'ignore multi-channel' ON

calculations.name: Break-even ACOS
calculations.formula: (PPC profit + ad spend) / PPC sales (documented); null when PPC sales ≤ 0
calculations.note: OMITTED v0.3 — marketing function removed by Owner 2026-10-10; not to be built

calculations.name: Estimated payout
calculations.formula: sales − fees excl. TDS − refunds − tds_withheld − TCS − reserves; identical under either item_tds_presentation; labelled estimate

calculations.name: Sellerboard-compatible gross profit stack (Amazon & Shopify variants)
calculations.formula: Amazon: Sales+Promo+Advertising+Shipping+Giftwrap+Refund cost+Amazon fees+COGS+Output tax (signed). Shopify (reconciled): Sales+Advertising+Shipping costs+Payment fees+COGS+Tax (signed); Pick&pack and Chargebacks lines PROPOSED pending placement check

calculations.name: Sellerboard-compatible net profit & CM reconciliation
calculations.formula: GP_compat + indirect + variable expenses (signed); must equal CALC-013 net profit on identical inputs

calculations.name: Output tax line (VAT/GST/MF-VAT) with completeness check
calculations.formula: tax portion of tax-inclusive sales by head (IGST | CGST+SGST | VAT | MF-VAT) net of refunded tax; flag when CGST ≠ SGST

calculations.name: % Refunds (units basis)
calculations.formula: refunded/returned units / units sold; null when units 0

calculations.name: Sellable returns %
calculations.formula: sellable (restocked) returned units / returned units; null when 0

calculations.name: PPC profit (estimated)
calculations.formula: PPC sales + promo + ad spend + refunds + fees + COGS + output tax + expenses (signed); promo/refund/fee per PPC order = previous-month per-order averages × PPC orders
calculations.note: OMITTED v0.3 — marketing function removed by Owner 2026-10-10; not to be built

calculations.name: Ad unit metrics
calculations.formula: CPC=spend/clicks; CTR=clicks/impressions; CPM=spend/impressions×1000; CPO=spend/orders; CVR=orders/clicks; budget utilisation=spend/(daily budget×days)
calculations.note: OMITTED v0.3 — marketing function removed by Owner 2026-10-10; not to be built

calculations.name: Break-even bid
calculations.formula: break-even ACOS / ACOS × CPC; null when ACOS 0
calculations.note: OMITTED v0.3 — marketing function removed by Owner 2026-10-10; not to be built

calculations.name: Day-parting bid (write — conditional)
calculations.formula: min(base bid × multiplier[day,hour], max bid); multipliers rebuilt nightly from trailing 28 days
calculations.note: OMITTED v0.3 — marketing function removed by Owner 2026-10-10; not to be built

calculations.name: Blended ROAS, POAS, MER
calculations.formula: Blended ROAS = Sales / total ad spend; POAS = net profit / total ad spend; null when spend 0

calculations.name: Amazon Attribution campaign profit & ROAS
calculations.formula: attributed sales − spend − COGS − fees − output tax; ROAS = attributed sales / spend (14-day window)
calculations.note: OMITTED v0.3 — marketing function removed by Owner 2026-10-10; not to be built

calculations.name: Dual attribution view (platform-reported vs first/last-visit attributed)
calculations.formula: separate columns; unattributed = total sales − attributed; NCR = new-customer orders / attributed orders; attributed_roas = attributed sales / spend; CPO = spend / attributed orders; CVR = attributed orders / clicks (OBS-R); AOV_attr; attributed profit (PROPOSED); order_index; never summed into sales
calculations.note: OMITTED v0.3 — marketing function removed by Owner 2026-10-10; not to be built

calculations.name: Days until next order
calculations.formula: Sellerboard-compatible default: days of cover (CALC-038) − (manufacturing + shipping + buffer days); optional non-compat basis includes incoming + ordered stock

calculations.name: Stock value, potential sales, potential profit
calculations.formula: units × unit COGS | price | profit per unit

calculations.name: Funds needed & sales/profit at risk (PROPOSED)
calculations.formula: Σ reorder qty × unit cost; at-risk = velocity × price|profit × min(30, max(0, lead − days of stock))

calculations.name: Missed profit (stockout)
calculations.formula: OOS days (trailing 90) × velocity × average profit per unit

calculations.name: Profit per unit (product estimate)
calculations.formula: price − output tax − COGS − fulfilment fee − referral fee − shipping per unit

calculations.name: Fee allocation (inbound by volume/weight; account-level fees by driver)
calculations.formula: allocate per driver with conservation (CALC-023); unallocated bucket shown, never dropped

calculations.name: Reimbursement gap
calculations.formula: max(0, unit COGS − reimbursement per unit) × units

calculations.name: FBA fee overcharge estimate
calculations.formula: (new fee − reference fee) × units since change when |Δ| > tolerance

calculations.name: Refund-without-return candidate
calculations.formula: refund + policy days (default 45) ≤ as-of ≤ refund + lookback (105); no return, no reimbursement → refunded amount

calculations.name: Lost/damaged candidate (PROPOSED value basis)
calculations.formula: (lost + damaged − found − reimbursed) units × unit COGS (conservative)

calculations.name: SnS revenue penetration
calculations.formula: SnS sales / total sales (completed months)

calculations.name: Cashflow running balance & 3-period forecast (PROPOSED)
calculations.formula: cash_t = cash_{t−1} + payouts + investments − expenses − goods − dividends; forecast = mean net of last 3 periods

calculations.name: Search-term share
calculations.formula: my / total for impressions, clicks, add-to-cart, purchases
calculations.note: OMITTED v0.3 — marketing function removed by Owner 2026-10-10; not to be built

calculations.name: Repricer guardrail envelope
calculations.formula: upper = min(max price, CPT, 1.25×90-d median, 1.5×initial, 1.5×Was price); lower = max(floor (CALC-041), 0.5×initial); lower > upper → hold + alert

calculations.name: Shopify revenue composition
calculations.formula: Sales = gross sales − discounts + shipping charged − refunded amount; tips memo-only; gift-card sales excluded until redemption; chargebacks cost line

calculations.name: Return shipping, return processing, country surcharge
calculations.formula: per returned item | package; surcharge by destination country

calculations.name: COGS variants: tiered and % of price
calculations.formula: tiered: unit cost by quantity break; % of list price or of selling price incl. shipping & promo

calculations.name: Advertising cost composition
calculations.formula: Advertising line = Σ ad spend by source (Amazon Ads, Google, Meta, Walmart Connect/SEM, CSV-imported platforms) + flagged expenses + non-recoverable local GST on ads; spend only — no attribution (marketing omitted v0.3)

calculations.name: Grade & Resell COGS guard
calculations.formula: resell unit COGS excludes original unit COGS (no double count)

calculations.name: Presentation FX (compat mode)
calculations.formula: display conversion at rate of last day of selected period when toggle ON; ledger keeps CALC-026 policy

calculations.name: Refund booking date policy
calculations.formula: refund date (default) | original order date | release date (deferred refunds)

calculations.name: Repeat customer (brand-scoped)
calculations.formula: buyers with >1 order of the same brand in period / buyers

calculations.name: Trailing-window LTV set
calculations.formula: customers, new customers, acc. sales/units/orders/profit per customer, repurchase rate, avg days between orders, CAC, ROAS, POAS within window W

calculations.name: BSR snapshot & delta
calculations.formula: latest rank; delta vs previous snapshot; display-only

calculations.name: PO close → cost batch with freight allocation
calculations.formula: unit landed cost = unit price + allocated freight (by units | volume | weight)

calculations.name: Product master identity & matching
calculations.formula: match on ASIN/SKU/EAN/UPC/Shopify variant; one COGS master shared by channels

calculations.name: PPC bid recommendation (PROPOSED transparent rule)
calculations.formula: new bid = current × clamp(target ACOS / actual ACOS, 1 − step, 1 + step); min clicks threshold
calculations.note: OMITTED v0.3 — marketing function removed by Owner 2026-10-10; not to be built

calculations.name: Profit forecast (30 days)
calculations.formula: min(velocity × 30, available) × profit per unit

calculations.name: Order inclusion rules
calculations.formula: exclude by status / channel / tag (e.g., COD cancelled); excluded orders retain attributable costs per setting

calculations.name: Variable expense bases
calculations.formula: % of sales | % of list price | per order | per unit | % of platform ad spend; optional show under advertising

calculations.name: Location→warehouse mapping & shared stock pools
calculations.formula: each physical unit counted once across Shopify locations, B2B warehouses, FBA

calculations.name: B2B taxable value
calculations.formula: qty × list price × (1 − line disc%) − allocated invoice discount; ex-GST

calculations.name: GST split by place of supply
calculations.formula: same state → CGST+SGST (rate/2 each); other state → IGST; export/SEZ under LUT → 0; rate from HSN master

calculations.name: B2B net sales
calculations.formula: Σ taxable value + taxable freight charged − credit-note taxable value; excludes GST

calculations.name: B2B COGS & free goods
calculations.formula: billed (dispatched) units × COGS policy at dispatch warehouse; FOC/sample units → 'Free goods & samples' expense

calculations.name: B2B contribution
calculations.formula: net sales − COGS − freight borne − schemes/rebates − commission − bank charges − free goods & samples

calculations.name: Receivables, aging, DSO
calculations.formula: outstanding = invoice total − receipts − TDS withheld − credit notes; TDS = rate × incremental taxable above the per-seller FY threshold; aging buckets; overdue vs terms; MSME flag = seller Udyam-registered AND outstanding > 0 AND age > min(terms, 45); DSO = receivables / credit sales × window days

calculations.name: Export invoice FX & realisation
calculations.formula: INR at invoice-date rate; realised gain/loss on receipt; flag unrealised > 9 months

calculations.name: B2B dedup & intercompany elimination
calculations.formula: block duplicates vs Shopify draft orders/Amazon Business by reference; intercompany sales eliminated in consolidated view

calculations.name: Unified consolidation & channel mix
calculations.formula: Σ channels (Amazon, Shopify, B2B, …) in reporting currency; channel share = channel sales / total; entity view vs consolidated view

calculations.name: B2B compliance flags (read-only)
calculations.formula: IRN required when AATO > ₹5 cr (IRN_MISSING); IRN_LATE when AATO ≥ ₹10 cr and doc age > 30 d without IRN; e-way bill required if consignment value > threshold (state-configurable); HSN digit rule

calculations.name: Commission, price realisation, ECL provision
calculations.formula: commission = rate × basis (invoiced|collected); realisation = net price / list price; ECL = Σ bucket × provision %

calculations.name: RTO / COD cost
calculations.formula: forward + return shipping + COD fee + return-damage; RTO orders excluded from sales, costs retained

calculations.name: Actual courier/3PL cost replaces shipping-profile estimate
calculations.formula: applied = actual when matched to order else profile estimate (flag ESTIMATE)

calculations.name: Replenishment cycle (cartridge/candle) due & repurchase
calculations.formula: due date = last system/cartridge purchase + configured cycle days; repurchase rate = buyers repurchasing within cycle + grace / buyers due

calculations.name: Target / budget vs actual
calculations.formula: variance = actual − target; % = variance / target; null when target 0

calculations.name: Period comparison Δ / Δ% (tiles, P&L compare, YoY, trends)
calculations.formula: Δ = current − prior; Δ% = Δ / |prior|, null when prior = 0; MTD/Today compare same elapsed days of prior period; YoY maps 29 Feb to 28 Feb

calculations.name: Amazon shipping & giftwrap charges and chargebacks (PROPOSED mapping)
calculations.formula: Shipping line = ShippingCharge + ShippingChargeback; Giftwrap line = GiftWrap + GiftwrapChargeback; display toggle does not change profit

calculations.name: Intercompany COGS and unrealised-profit-in-stock elimination
calculations.formula: eliminate IC sales and IC purchases; unrealised profit = (IC price − IC cost) × share of IC stock unsold at period end

calculations.name: Region attribution for Map view
calculations.formula: Shopify ship-to state/country; B2B place of supply; Amazon region via region-level report or Restricted Data Token (RDT) only if approved; else UNKNOWN

calculations.name: PPC search-term and budget recommendations (PROPOSED, no parity claim)
calculations.formula: HARVEST if orders ≥ n and ACOS ≤ target; NEGATE if clicks ≥ m and (orders = 0 or ACOS > k × target); budget raise if utilisation > x% and ACOS < target

calculations.name: Marketplace tax regime resolution (all Amazon marketplaces)
calculations.formula: regime from marketplace master: seller-liable VAT/GST/consumption tax → shown as signed output-tax line (CALC-050); marketplace-facilitator collected & remitted tax (e.g. US sales tax, MF-VAT) → tax collected and tax withheld net to zero and are excluded from Sales and from the tax line; regime and start date per marketplace (PROPOSED, parity checked per marketplace)

calculations.name: Channel fee & settlement mapping (Walmart, eBay, TikTok Shop) to compat lines
calculations.formula: each source fee/charge type maps via a versioned table to one compat line (Sales, Promo, Shipping, Refund cost, Marketplace fees, Advertising, Tax); unmapped types → 'Unclassified fees' + UNCLASSIFIED_FEE alert; Σ mapped lines = Σ source amounts (conservation) (PROPOSED)

requirements.acceptance: Fixture GV-030: sales unchanged when attributed revenue present.

requirements.text: A Shopify order and its MCF/WFS fulfillment record shall count as one sale with fulfillment fees retained.
Unknown fee codes shall land in an 'Unclassified' bucket and raise an alert; never dropped.
Actual charges replace their estimates; never both.
Landed duty/freight is included in COGS or expenses, never both.
Unsellable returns shall not restore saleable inventory.
Cost layers apply by order date; today's batch never reprices old sales.
Missing COGS shall be reported as null with 'incomplete' flag, never as zero cost.
Aggregate margin = Σprofit/Σsales, never average of row margins; zero denominators → null.
LTV windows longer than cohort age are flagged immature; no cross-market identity inferred.
Repeat orders are not labelled subscriptions unless a contract source exists.
Minimum price never rounds below exact floor; overrides cannot bypass hard constraints.
Closed periods are immutable; late corrections post to the open period with lineage.
Source failure yields 'stale/missing' status, never zero sales or cost.
Every external write requires simulation, approval (maker≠checker), canary, idempotency key, kill switch check, and stale-data stop.

requirements.text: AI layer explains approved aggregates only; cannot compute authoritative numbers or execute changes.

requirements.text: Sellerboard-compatible P&L lines (CALC-050/051) and contribution-margin lines (CALC-010..013) shall reconcile to the same net profit for identical inputs.
Platform-reported ad sales and attributed sales are displayed in separate columns and are never added to business sales or to each other.
A posted B2B invoice is immutable; corrections only via credit note or cancellation with audit trail; GST split must follow place of supply.
Intercompany B2B sales are eliminated in the consolidated view and shown in the entity view only.
A B2B entry whose reference matches a Shopify draft order or Amazon Business order is blocked as duplicate unless explicitly linked.
When an actual courier/3PL charge exists it replaces the shipping-profile estimate; never both.
Tips are never revenue; gift-card sales are excluded from sales until redemption.
